def test_minPath():
    # Test case 1: 1 in the corner, k=3
    grid = [[1, 2, 3],
            [4, 5, 6],
            [7, 8, 9]]
    assert minPath(grid, 3) == [1, 2, 1]

    # Test case 2: 1 in the middle, k=1
    grid = [[5, 9, 3],
            [4, 1, 6],
            [7, 8, 2]]
    assert minPath(grid, 1) == [1]

    # Test case 3: 1 in the middle, k=4
    grid = [[5, 9, 3],
            [4, 1, 6],
            [7, 8, 2]]
    assert minPath(grid, 4) == [1, 4, 1, 4]

    # Test case 4: 1 at bottom-right corner, k=5
    grid = [[9, 8, 7],
            [6, 5, 4],
            [3, 2, 1]]
    assert minPath(grid, 5) == [1, 2, 1, 2, 1]

    # Test case 5: 2x2 grid, 1 at top-left, k=2
    grid = [[1, 3],
            [2, 4]]
    assert minPath(grid, 2) == [1, 2]

    # Test case 6: 1x1 grid (only value 1, no neighbors -> val stays n*n+1)
    grid = [[1]]
    assert minPath(grid, 3) == [1, 2, 1]  # n*n+1 = 2

    # Test case 7: larger grid, 1 not adjacent to smallest values
    grid = [[10, 20, 30],
            [40, 50, 60],
            [70, 80, 1]]
    assert minPath(grid, 6) == [1, 60, 1, 60, 1, 60]

    # Test case 8: k=0 returns empty list
    grid = [[1, 2],
            [3, 4]]
    assert minPath(grid, 0) == []

    print("All test cases passed!")


test_minPath()
